changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW active_member AS SELECT id, x_road_instance, member_class, member_code, name, is_provider, created, changed, fetched FROM member WHERE removed IS NULL;

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW active_subsystem AS SELECT ss.id, ss.member_id, ss.subsystem_code, ss.created, ss.changed, ss.fetched FROM subsystem ss JOIN member m ON ss.member_id = m.id WHERE ss.removed IS NULL AND m.removed IS NULL;

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW active_service AS SELECT s.id, s.subsystem_id, s.service_code, s.service_version, s.service_type, s.created, s.changed, s.fetched FROM service s JOIN subsystem ss ON s.subsystem_id = ss.id JOIN member m ON ss.member_id = m.id WHERE s.removed IS NULL AND ss.removed IS NULL AND m.removed IS NULL;

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW active_wsdl AS SELECT w.id, w.service_id, w.data, w.external_id, w.created, w.changed, w.fetched FROM wsdl w JOIN active_service s ON w.service_id = s.id WHERE w.removed IS NULL;

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW active_open_api AS SELECT o.id, o.service_id, o.data, o.external_id, o.created, o.changed, o.fetched FROM open_api o JOIN active_service s ON o.service_id = s.id WHERE o.removed IS NULL;

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW active_rest AS SELECT r.id, r.service_id, r.data, r.external_id, r.created, r.changed, r.fetched FROM rest r JOIN active_service s ON r.service_id = s.id WHERE r.removed IS NULL;

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW active_endpoint AS SELECT e.id, e.service_id, e.method, e.path, e.created, e.changed, e.fetched FROM endpoint e JOIN active_service s ON e.service_id = s.id WHERE e.removed IS NULL;

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.comment: Unified search surface: members, subsystems and per-subsystem service aggregates. Column semantics match the former SearchRepository union; the LIKE filter, pagination and total_count stay in the repository query.
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW active_search_index AS SELECT 'member' AS entity_type, m.id AS entity_id, LOWER(m.name) AS sort_key, m.member_class, m.member_code, m.name AS member_name, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS subsystem_code, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS service_code, m.is_provider, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS service_types FROM active_member m UNION ALL SELECT 'subsystem', sub.id, LOWER(sub.subsystem_code), m.member_class, m.member_code, m.name, sub.subsystem_code, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN), CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) FROM active_subsystem sub JOIN active_member m ON sub.member_id = m.id UNION ALL SELECT 'service', MIN(s.id), LOWER(s.service_code), m.member_class, m.member_code, m.name, sub.subsystem_code, s.service_code, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN), string_agg(DISTINCT s.service_type, ',' ORDER BY s.service_type) FROM active_service s JOIN active_subsystem sub ON s.subsystem_id = sub.id JOIN active_member m ON sub.member_id = m.id GROUP BY s.service_code, m.member_class, m.member_code, m.name, sub.subsystem_code;

changeSet.author: niis
changeSet.comment: The lister's read-only role reads the V2 API through these views. The collector never reads them, so it gets no grant.
changeSet.sql: GRANT SELECT ON active_member, active_subsystem, active_service, active_wsdl, active_open_api, active_rest, active_endpoint, active_search_index TO ${users.lister.username};
